title: Excel Source Manifest Schema v1.0
description: Per-sheet ownership + provenance contract (projects/{slug}/config/excel-source-manifest.json). Declares primary_owner, allowed_writers, source_ref/staging_tables, and projection_mode for every logical sheet. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §11.2 and §11.3.

workbook_id.description: Stable identifier for the workbook this manifest describes (e.g. 'master')

source_kinds.description: Closed list of source kinds used across sheets. Fixed enum — any new kind must be added to the plugin schema first.

primary_owner.description: Source-of-truth for this sheet. One of source_kinds OR a named pipeline tool.

allowed_writers.description: Named write actors. Writer name MUST be recognized by the projection tool or CSR validator. Common values: 'excel_project_json', 'excel_project_sf', 'mcp_feed', 'dashboard_refresh', 'done_protocol', 'master_task_sync', 'human'.

writer_scope.description: Per-writer scope descriptor (free-text). Defines which columns/ranges a writer may touch; enforced by done_protocol + master_task_sync tools.

source_ref.description: Relative path to the canonical source artifact (e.g. data/topical-map.json, config/dashboard-kpis.json)

staging_table.description: Single SQLite staging table name (preferred when one source feeds the sheet)

staging_tables.description: Multiple staging tables when projection aggregates across sources (e.g. tech_seo reads sf_urls + sf_issues + sf_response_codes)

enrichment_sources.description: Non-primary sources merged into the projection (e.g. cluster_keywords enriched by gsc_mcp + dataforseo_mcp)

manual_columns.description: Column names that humans own even when primary_owner is a tool (never overwritten by projection)

protected_columns.description: Columns reserved from auto-write by any non-human writer (master_task: task, category, priority, impact, duration, assignee, note)

computed_ranges.description: Cell ranges computed in-place at write time (e.g. master_task B62:B64). Format: 'A1:B2' or single 'A1'

projection_mode.description: Named projection strategy recognized by excel_project_* tools (e.g. row_match_by_url, merge_by_keyword_url, aggregate_by_page, issue_summary, aggregate_metrics, kpi_cells, append_with_is_brand_column)

freshness_sla_hours.description: Max age of source data before projection warns (MCP sources)

formula_policy.description: Enforces §8.3 zero-formula rule at the sheet level
